Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

Do you have a solid experience as a CE Truck Driver and enjoy delivering items from point A to point B? Then this might be exactly the opportunity you're looking for! We're looking for a reliable professional who takes pride in delivering vehicles in perfect condition.

In this role, you will take charge of transporting various vehicles, including vans and trucks, to different destinations. 

 
• Safely loading, securing, and unloading vehicles. 
Checking the load, transport documentation, and ensuring everything is delivered correctly. 

 
• Keeping the truck, trailer, and all equipment well-maintained and in top condition. 
 

 
• Providing a brief handover explanation when delivering the vehicle to the customer. 
 
• Representing the company professionally while on the road. 

 
• A valid CE driving license + Code 95. 
 
• Experience with vehicle loading, securing, and transport. 
 
•  
A precise, safety-focused way of working. 

 
•  
Proficiency in Dutch or English (French is a plus) 

 
•  
A friendly, professional communication style and appearance. 

 
•  
Flexibility: your schedule won't always be a standard 9-to-5; starting earlier or finishing later is part of the job.

VetPharm Global is an international partner in animal health, specialising in the distribution of veterinary medicines, vaccines and feed additives. From our head office in Belgium and through a commercial network and operations in Europe, Asia and South America, we support vets, producers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative and scientifically backed solutions. with a strong focus on quality, expertise and customer focus, we contribute to sustainable and effective animal health.
 

To support the further growth of our operations in Brazil, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager. 
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

SAS Global (Scientific Allied Solutions) is an independent partner in animal health, specialising in veterinary diagnostics, autogenous vaccines and contract research. With various subsidiaries and our head office in Belgium, and an international presence across Europe, Asia, Jordan and Brazil, we support vets, farmers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative solutions for healthier animals and more efficient production.
 

To support the continued growth of our three Brazilian subsidiaries, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager.
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

Let's talk business
 
 

• As an International Sales Manager you will be responsible for selling MES-systems to B2B customers in the global growth markets of textiles and plastics. 

• You focus on medium and large enterprises, and you'll speak to strategic decision makers (owners, general management, IT and production management). 

• In the countries where you operate, you will work together with sales agents. You research the market potential of your countries, select quality partners with a good reputation, evaluate their activities and visit prospects whose doors they will open. 

• You are responsible for preparing offers, launching marketing campaigns and making presentations. 

• You participate in national and international fairs. 

• You think along with the customer and convince them that BMS is their suitable partner for their Industry 4.0 strategy. 

Let's talk you
 
 

• You hold a technical or technical/economic Master's degree or you've built up equivalent expertise through experience, and you have a strong affinity with software-driven solutions. 

• Ideally, you bring around 10 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably within the manufacturing industry, where you have successfully positioned business operations or MES-related software. 

• You feel at ease collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and you have a proven track record in complex, project-driven sales environments with longer sales cycles. 

• You love to travel internationally frequently and you are interested in other cultures. 

• You communicate fluently in English, and any additional language skills, such as French, German, Italian, etc., are a strong asset. 

• Continuous learning energizes you. You enjoy negotiating, building long-term relationships and taking ownership. 

• You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong self-management skills, all within a collaborative corporate culture where pragmatism, intrapreneurship and responsibility truly matter.

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Responsibilities
 
 

• Study, specification, design and verification of high-quality digital and mixed-signal ICs 

• Write digital specifications for mixed-signal ICs, make area and power estimations 

• Technical team lead for the digital content of mixed-signal ASICs including interaction with customers, suppliers and the internal ASIC development team 

• Lead, attend and present at project/review meetings worldwide 

• Coach junior engineers in design, verification and testing of integrated circuits and improve their level of technical expertise and knowledge of the total business 

• Work together with international customers and communicate efficiently to successfully complete the project 

• Write documentation 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer with at least four years of experience in digital IC design 

• You have experience with front-end ASIC or FPGA design in VHDL and/or Verilog and/or SystemVerilog 

• You have experience with front-end verification, preferably in SystemVerilog + UVM, to write directed tests, constrained randomized tests and to gather and interpret metrics such as code/condition/FSM/toggle/functional coverage 

• You have experience with digital synthesis, logic equivalence checking (LEC) and Static Timing Analysis (STA) 

• Experience with UPF and/or CPF and DFT and ATPG is a plus 

• Experience with scripting and programming languages such as Python and C is a plus 

• Experience with any of the following protocols and techniques is a plus: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, LIN, SENT, DSP, CRC, FSM design, MCU 

• You are a self-motivated, efficient professional able to work alone or in teams 

• You offer quality and reliability to colleagues, customers and management, willing to share knowledge and able to communicate efficiently 

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

As the Business Partner – HR & WFM, you will act as the key bridge between local business domains and TDDI by capturing business needs, translating them into IT requirements, and connecting with regional TDDI to deliver effective solutions. You align IT initiatives with business priorities, fosters strong stakeholder relationships, and ensures that IT investments generate measurable business value. 

• 

Actively participate in the Regional Community of Practice (CoP) within the Application domain, exchanging knowledge and best practices with colleagues across the region. 

• 

Contribute to the business domain and TDDI roadmap by gathering business needs, including cost and budget considerations, and aligning them with the relevant TDDI solution centers. 

• 

Act as a local demand or portfolio manager within the TDDI Demand Management process by clarifying business demand, ensuring alignment with TDDI policies and guidelines, and facilitating the approval of local or cluster initiatives with the appropriate experts. 

• 

Serve as a local ambassador for TDDI transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment between regional objectives and the needs of one or more business domains. 

• 

Bridge regional, cluster, or country business requirements with TDDI’s technical capabilities and services. 

• 

Coordinate change delivery, major incident management, temporary fixes, and workarounds for applications and systems within the Application domain at global, regional, and local levels. 

• 

Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers operating within the scope of the Application domain. 

• 

Monitor KPIs and performance dashboards for local solutions to ensure service quality and drive continuous improvement. 

• 

Solid understanding of one or more Sodexo business and application domains  

• 

Familiarity with support tier structures and vendor coordination  

• 

Knowledge of product management concepts  

• 

Ability to work independently and coordinate with remote teams  

• 

Ability to distinguish presented user requests from underlying true needs, and distinguish solution ideas from requirements  

• 

Strong communication in both English and the local languages as well as stakeholder management skills

As an Office Assistant you will be the first point of contact for employees, visitors and service providers, ensuring a welcoming and professional workplace experience. You will combine front-of-house responsibilities with workplace and facilities coordination to support the smooth day-to-day operations of a modern and dynamic office environment.

 

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

 

 

Description

As Office Assistant, you will be the main point of contact within the office and help ensure a seamless workplace experience.

• Welcome employees, visitors, contractors and suppliers in a professional and friendly manner.
• Coordinate workplace and facility services to support daily operations.
• Manage and follow up on maintenance requests and service tickets.
• Provide administrative support to the onsite management team.
• Ensure compliance with security, health & safety and emergency procedures.
• Respond to questions, requests and complaints while delivering excellent service.

 

• You have at least a first experience in reception, hospitality, facilities or office management.
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Service minded, customer oriented with excellent communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and solution-oriented attitude.
• Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel).

Our client is a wholesale company based in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, specialized in the distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables in Belgium and the Netherlands.

For decades, this wholesale organization has been active in the fresh produce sector, using its knowledge and experience every day to search for opportunities, innovations, and top-quality products.

They can rightfully call themselves a leading player in the distribution, import, and export of fruit and vegetables.

Would you like to be part of their team?

Our client is looking for a motivated CE truck driver!

• Holder of a CE driving license with valid Code 95.
• Hard worker, committed to your job, with respect for customers, colleagues, and entrusted equipment.
• Not afraid of loading and unloading yourself.
• You will be the company’s calling card.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your CV today, and we’ll get to work for you!

REF:MEC

• CE driving license.
• Code 95.
• Initial experience in distribution is an asset.
• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays.
• Flexible, customer-oriented, and punctual.
• Flexible availability for both day and night shifts (both are required).
• Good knowledge of Dutch or French and English (understanding, writing, and speaking).

To support the continued growth of ARCHE Consulting dealing with chemical and product health, sustainability, safety and environmental programs of multi-national corporations from varied industrial sectors, we are looking for a Junior Environmental Consultant (m/f/x) to join our team in Ghent or Leuven.

As a Junior Environmental Consultant you will be:

• 
part of our Cradle to Cradle (C2C) team and assist companies in the Cradle to Cradle certification process (https://www.arche-consulting.be/our-services/cradle-to-cradle-certification/ [https://www.arche-consulting.be/en/our-services/sustainability/cradle-to-cradle]) and circular economy;

• 
providing support and assist in technical dossier preparation for different chemical regulations (REACH, biocides transitional dossiers);

• 
remaining aware of updates in regulatory guidance within your field;

• 
communicating with clients and regulatory authorities if necessary.

Minimum qualifications:

• 
Bachelor degree in environmental sciences, chemistry and/or related sub-disciplines

Required skills:

• 
You adopt a customer-oriented approach

• 
Solid organizational skills to handle short tasks, requests and checks

• 
Broad interest in chemicals / biocides efficacy, physico-chemistry, risk assessment and sustainability

• 
Fluent in English

• 
Outstanding oral and written communication skills, enabling you to communicate effectively with internal staff and external clients and management

Additional qualifications considered beneficial:

• 
1-2 years experience in a similar position is a big plus but not a prerequisite

• 
You are familiar with Python and SQL knowledge

• 
You demonstrate a strong work ethic and a positive attitude

• 
You like to have fun both in your work and with the team

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a DIAGNOSIC TECHNICIAN.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a diagnosic technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;

jobs.occupation: AI Innovation Specialist | Welcome in AI World

Drive AI innovation in a global organization, turning business ideas into impactful AI solutions while shaping the future of digital transformation.

Join a leadinginternational risk management and financial services organizationwith a strong global presence and a collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence.

 

We are looking for anAI Integration Analystto accelerate the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the organization. In this role, you will identify high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical implementation plans, and support the successful deployment and adoption of AI solutions.
AI Innovation Specialist - What's the job about ?
• Identify and prioritizeAI use cases through workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
• Translate business needsinto practical AI and automation solutions with measurable impact.
• Coordinate and supportthe implementation and integration of AI initiatives across the organization.
• Promote AI adoptionthrough communication, training, and user support, with a focus on Agentic AI.
• Collaboratewith Security, Compliance, and international teams to ensure secure and compliant AI solutions.
• Drive AI maturityby contributing to capability building and continuous improvement initiatives.
AI Innovation Specialist - Who Are You ?
• Experience inAI,digital transformation, project management or process improvement, ideally within a regulated environment.
• Strong understanding ofGenerative AI,Agentic AI, and their practical business applications.
• Knowledge ofAPIs, data flows, and system integration concepts.
• Experience supportingchange management, user adoption, training, and stakeholder engagement.
• Good understanding ofsecurity, compliance, and governance considerations related to AI solutions.
• Fluent inDutchandEnglish; French is considered an advantage.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
 

Our Guest Experience Experts
 
 

• take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. 

• They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. 

• Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.  

 
 

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
 

Guest Experience Experts
 
 

• will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). 

• Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time 
 

• Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent. 

• Related Work Experience: No related work experience. 

• Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience. 

• License or Certification: None 

• Languages: English is mandatory, other languages are a plus

Job description 

For a large transport company, you will be working in their distribution center, moving trailers from the parking area to the loading docks and vice versa. You will do this using a Terberg (terminal tractor), a machine specifically designed for this task.

You will communicate via onboard radio with the planning team, who will assign your tasks. For smooth communication, a good knowledge of Dutch or English is required.

There are different shifts: from 04:00 to 14:00, from 05:00 to 17:00, or from 14:00 to 22:00.

A C/CE driving license is required, but Code 95 is not necessary.

 Requirements 

    
• C/CE driving license
    
• Good parking skills with tractor-trailer
    
• Sense of responsibility and focus on safety
    
• Ability to handle stress
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Who are we?

In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient. The ability to rapidly detect and respond to threats is essential. Organizations are increasingly turning to trusted strategic partners who can fully unburden them in the domain of detection and response.

That’s where we come in. We offer MDR as a value service to a broad spectrum of customers across different verticals – all equally exciting.

Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we help companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions with confidence. We proudly serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.

At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.

Your mission: what can you expect from the job?

You will join our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) teams with a strong focus on security automation and orchestration. As a Security Automation Engineer, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and maintain automated response capabilities using Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.

Your work will directly impact how efficiently and consistently security incidents are handled across complex customer environments. You will help scale our MDR service by translating detection signals into automated, reliable, and auditable response workflows.

We strongly believe in SOAR as code: automation content is version-controlled, tested, and continuously improved.

You will contribute to and integrate with the following technologies:

• Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR
• Microsoft Defender XDR and other XDR platforms
• SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel and others)
• ITSM platforms (ServiceNow and equivalents)
• Cloud, identity, network, and third-party security tooling
Key Responsibilities

Security Automation & Playbook Development

• Design, build, and maintain response playbooks in Cortex XSOAR for common and advanced security incidents.
• Translate detection alerts from SIEM and XDR platforms into automated investigation and response flows.
• Implement conditional logic, enrichment steps, human-in-the-loop approvals, and automated containment actions.
SOAR as Code

• Manage playbooks, integrations, scripts, and content packs using version control (Git).
• Apply software engineering best practices such as modularity, reusability, testing, and peer review.
• Contribute to standardized automation frameworks that can be reused across customers.
Platform Integrations

• Build and maintain integrations between XSOAR and:
• SIEM platforms o XDR / EDR solutions
• ITSM tools (incident creation, updates, closures) o Identity, network, and cloud security controls
• Troubleshoot and optimize integrations for reliability, performance, and scalability.
Incident Response Enablement

• Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering and Incident Response teams to define:
• Automated investigation steps o Response actions and containment strategies o Escalation and handover points to analysts
• Continuously improve response quality based on real incident feedback.
Automation Lifecycle Management

• Maintain and evolve our automation content library.
• Tune playbooks to reduce noise, false positives, and manual 

Hello, is it me you’re looking for?

• You are passionate about IT security and automation, with several years of relevant professional experience.
• You have hands-on experience with SOAR platforms, preferably Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.
• You are comfortable building response playbooks and automations end-toend.
• You strongly believe in automation as code and have experience with Gitbased workflows.
• Basic system engineering knowledge (Windows, Linux, networking, identity) is a plus.
• You have experience integrating security platforms such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, IAM, or ITSM tools.
• You understand security operations and incident response processes.
• Experience with scripting (Python, JavaScript) is a strong plus.
• You communicate smoothly in Dutch and English (written and oral). French is a plus.
• 
You are analytical, structured, and not afraid to challenge existing processes to improve them.
